description: This Java class defines the data structure for client charges within the Fineract portfolio management system. It encapsulates pertinent details such as charge identifiers, status flags, related date and monetary information, and associated charge and transaction data.

classes.name: ClientChargeData
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a client's charge, including associated payment and status details.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ClientChargeData instance with specified attributes.

methods.name: addAssociations
methods.description: Enhances a ClientChargeData object by associating it with a collection of client transaction data.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a template ClientChargeData object with null or default fields, useful for initialization.
